new_operators.MUT-CFG-001: Boolean literal inversion on resource/local configurations, module inputs (M), and scalar variable defaults (V). General configuration faults, no inferred security claim.
new_operators.MUT-RES-004: Positive count/capacity -> zero on curated provisioning attributes and scalar defaults.
new_operators.MUT-SEC-005: EC2 IMDSv2 http_tokens required -> optional, scoped AWS instance/launch template.
new_operators.MUT-SEC-006: Storage encryption true -> false for EFS/Redshift, separated from unchanged original SEC002.

scope_change: Conservative selected-run caller/default binding analysis; missing argument or explicit null to non-nullable default can be eligible. Independently supplied literals/expression to nullable child shadow defaults. Unresolved nullability/JSON/parser cases excluded. Potential reachability, not runtime coverage.
deduplication: Identical offset/replacement/deletion counted once; earlier specialized operator retains attribution.
prequalification: Apply actual frozen operators to selected test/local module closure; baseline native pass and actual scored mutations still required. No selection by kill rate. Static no-target and screening-blocked candidates retained.
comparison: Legacy 12 subset retained in each version3 run with same engine, inputs, resolver and provider lock; report new operator families separately. Historical v2 results and matched 123-case comparison remain separate.
assertion_policy: No new adaptations to source assertions, mocks or test values. Old23 executed from frozen historically adapted sources, labeled separately.

validation.native_canaries: Both Terraform1.16.7 and OpenTofu1.12.3: three assertion-killed canaries each, child default, capacity and explicit module flag. Excluded from research.

sources.role: Configuration Data, Conditional, Security and Dependency defect taxonomy motivates families; not proof these exact mutations reproduce measured bugs.
Standard literal replacement, redundancy and mutation cost; boolean adaptation is our design, no novelty claim.
Required tokens restrict IMDSv2; optional permits IMDSv1/2.
encrypted configuration boolean; provider validation still gates mutants.
Redshift encrypted configuration; provider validation still gates mutants.
Native OpenTofu tests and file precedence.

limits: Exploratory convenience sample with owner/provider clustering; a larger count alone does not establish generalizability.
Literal-only mutations do not cover every expression, object default, remote dependency, or equivalent/inactive case.
Neither operator number nor taxonomy mapping establishes novel or representative real-fault coverage.
Do not merge different tool versions into one reported primary mutation percentage.
